symptoms: Lower leaves turning yellow with dark concentric rings or brown spots.
recommendation: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/liter or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/liter. Avoid wetting foliage during irrigation.

symptoms: Heavy rainfall predicted or standing water in root zones.
recommendation: Stop drip irrigation immediately. Open field boundary trenches to drain excess water. Do not apply nitrogen fertilizers while soil is saturated.

symptoms: Ragged feeding holes on whorl leaves with sawdust-like frass.
recommendation: Apply whorl application of Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/liter of water or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.4ml/liter.

symptoms: Vegetative to early flowering stage nutrient needs.
recommendation: Top dress with Urea @ 25kg/acre and MOP (Muriate of Potash) @ 15kg/acre if soil moisture is adequate. For red soil, apply Zinc Sulphate 0.5% foliar spray if interveinal chlorosis appears.
source: ICAR Package of Practices for Vegetable Crops
